meta.rule: Rates are a dated log. There is no single 'hotel price' value anywhere in this file. Each observation records what was seen, when, on which page, and whether it is a quote for specific dates.
meta.tax_note: Clark County room tax 13.38% is confirmed on The Venetian's own hotel terms (V_TERMS). Wynn's terms page states the resort fee but not the tax rate; 13.38% is a county-wide rate, not a Wynn statement, so Wynn totals use it and are labelled 'derived'.
meta.walk_note: One labelled OSRM 8x8 distance matrix (MAP_OSRM_8, 2026-11-17) supplies every route figure. Minutes = metres / 4.8 km/h * 60 * 1.25; the 25% allowance covers street crossings, the pedestrian bridges over Las Vegas Blvd, elevators and casino corridors. The same formula is applied to every pair. Each pair also records the reverse-direction route: where the two differ by more than 20% the row is marked route_asymmetric and the reverse distance is shown, because the difference can be a real one-way pedestrian funnel or a geocoder snap artefact, and silently choosing one number would hide that. These are NOT Google or Apple Maps numbers, no casino publishes walking times, and none of it models the indoor walk from your tower to the poker room.
meta.true_cost_formula: true_cost_per_night = (room_rate + resort_fee) x (1 + room_tax_rate). Parking is added separately when the user is driving and not covered by play.
meta.default_tax_note: Clark County room tax 13.38%, printed on The Venetian's hotel terms (V_TERMS). Applied to properties that do not print their own rate; labelled with a dagger wherever it appears.

hotels.name: The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
hotels.towers: The Venetian and The Palazzo (one resort, two towers)
hotels.resort_fee_excerpt: Rates include a daily Resort Fee of $55 plus tax per night, payable upon check-in.
hotels.room_tax_excerpt: Daily rates do not include the applicable Clark County Room Tax of 13.38%.

parking.poker_play_waiver: 3+ hours of tournament or cash play = complimentary self-parking for the day (supervisor must confirm)
parking.excerpt: The daily fee for registered hotel guests is $20/day, seven days a week. For non-hotel guests, the fee is $20/day Monday – Thursday, and $25/day Friday – Sunday. Valet parking is $40/day. … Players in the poker room who play three hours or more in tournament or cash games will receive complimentary self-parking for the day.

cancellation.published: Depends on the rate booked; the hotel terms describe a deposit at booking and prepaid offers being non-cancellable and non-refundable. The poker rate itself requires booking by phone (code EPOKR25) and the terms page does not print a poker-rate cancellation deadline.
cancellation.excerpt: A deposit for your stay, including suite, fee, and tax, will be billed upon reservation confirmation. … For prepaid offers, a deposit for the entire stay … will be charged at the time of booking. Unless stated otherwise in the offer, bookings made using a prepaid offer are non-cancellable and non-refundable.
